No extrapolation to dimension beyond three is made.

value.rationale: Q3 is the first cube where the centered ball operator has four genuinely distinct ball radii, so the question whether radii two/three improve strong Hilbert amplification is intrinsic, not an arbitrary enumerated slice. Exact elimination of those candidates plus rigid parity extremizers fills a natural sharp-constant gap between prior finite-graph strong norms and dimension-free hypercube bounds. Coincidence with K3,3 despite different diameters is a structural phenomenon. A complete exact invariant and equality classification is valuable without a theorem for all dimensions.
